voice.transcript: Hey, Nidhi. I made this to say I'm sorry and to remember our story.
Sometime in November 2023, after my birthday, we were on a regular night call. Then the words finally came: I love you.
Recently, I said we should break up, and I said, I don't love you anymore. Those were my words. I am sorry I spoke to you that way.
I'm sorry, Nidhi. You don't owe me an answer. Whatever you need next, I will respect it.
